Front-End Developer
jobs.description: Front-End Developer Luxoft Gurugram, Haryana, India 11 hours ago Over 200 applicants See who Luxoft has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job Project Description: Responsible for designing, building, and supporting high-quality front-end applications for client onboarding, a strategic platform for modernising product onboarding, bid capture, regulatory processes, and sales enablement across wholesale banking. The role will contribute to building modern user interfaces, including user-facing front-end journeys, workflows, validation screens, navigation patterns, and integration experiences. The Front-End Engineer will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, UX Designers, Back-End Engineers, Architects, and platform teams to deliver secure, accessible, performant, and maintainable user experiences aligned with engineering standards Responsibilities: • Design, develop, and maintain front-end components and application screens that support error recovery, validation, and operational resilience. • Build responsive, accessible, and reusable user interface components. • Implement user-facing workflows for product onboarding, lead capture, validation, confirmation, and operational processing. • Ensure front-end implementation aligns with approved UX designs, design standards, and engineering guardrails. • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions, component patterns, and state management approaches. • Ensure user interface behaviour is consistent, reliable, and supportable across the platform. • Implement front-end patterns required for application navigation, sidebar integration, and seamless switching between applications. • Support integration of application screens with platform-level capabilities such as authentication, navigation, audit capture, and user context. • Work with platform teams to ensure front-end delivery aligns with mini-app standards and deployment practices. • Collaborate with Solution Designers and Architects to align front-end implementation with the overall solution design. • Write unit, integration, and UI tests for front-end components and workflows. • Support field-level workshops, screen flow reviews, and usability feedback sessions. Mandatory Skills Description: • 5+ years of experience in front-end engineering or full-stack engineering with a strong front-end focus. • Strong hands-on experience building enterprise-grade React applications with solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills. • Experience delivering front-end applications in complex technology environments and integrating front-end applications with REST APIs. • Experience working with component-based front-end architecture, API-driven architectures, and distributed systems. • Experience working in Agile delivery teams with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Designers, Engineers, and Architects. • Experience in banking, financial services, Markets, client onboarding, or workflow platforms is desirable. • Strong understanding of component-based front-end architecture, browser performance, accessibility, and secure front-end development. • Experience with CI/CD tools and modern engineering workflows. • Ability to troubleshoot complex front-end and integration issues. Nice-to-Have Skills Description: • Experience with product onboarding, Lead Management, order capture, or sales workflow platforms. • Experience in greenfield implementation of CRM applications. • Experience with customer and reference data integration. jobs.description: Sr. AI Engineer (Fullstack) Cyara Hyderabad, Telangana, India 13 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who Cyara has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job As the global leader in AI-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI-powered channels. Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale. As enterprises race to deploy agentic AI, the defining question is no longer whether AI can handle customer interactions, it’s whether those interactions can be trusted. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers. Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better. Primary Skills: 5+ years of strong exp in AI & Full stack environment AI/ML & Generative AI Expertise Extensive professional experience in Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) with Python Proven, hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions using LLMs (e.g., RAG systems, fine-tuning, prompt engineering) Deep understanding of ML and LLM/NLP evaluation techniques (e.g., precision, recall, F1 and metrics for assessing hallucination, relevance, and context) Demonstrable experience integrating AI/ML models into applications via APIs, microservices, and other integration patterns Experience analyzing and benchmarking model performance across multiple datasets and use cases Strong understanding of AI trustworthiness principles, including model accuracy, interpretability, robustness, and responsible AI practices Secondary Skills: Fullstack Expertise Extensive professional experience in full-stack development Strong proficiency in backend development with NodeJS Strong proficiency in front-end development with React Deep experience with database design and management, specifically Postgres and general SQL Proven experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, Bedrock, SageMaker) Proven track record in designing and maintaining enterprise-grade, scalable web applications Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) Good to have skills - AI Agents, Agentic AI, MCP Why you should join us: Looking for a place where your ideas matter, your growth is accelerated, and your work creates real impact? Welcome to Cyara. We're building the assurance layer that gives enterprises the confidence to deploy agentic AI at scale with a global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Whether you're launching new ideas, solving complex problems, or learning from talented colleagues across the world, you'll be surrounded by people who challenge and support you to do your best work. At Cyara, inclusivity isn't a buzzword, it's part of who we are. We foster a culture where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to contribute. Pair that with competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, flexible work options, recognition programs, and a strong focus on employee well-being, and you've got a workplace designed for both success and fulfilment. Big opportunities. Real impact. Amazing people. That's the Cyara experience. Cyara’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusive and Belonging Statement: At Cyara, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace that embodies equal opportunity and champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). We strive to cultivate an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, contributing unique perspectives and talents. Our commitment includes continuously evaluating and enhancing our policies, practices, and culture to align with our DEIB principles. We ensure a discrimination-free environment where individuals are evaluated solely on their merits and abilities, regardless of legally protected statuses such as sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or medical condition. By celebrating our differences and championing inclusivity, we enrich our organization, make more thoughtful decisions, and drive collective success. Cyara’s Values Statement: At Cyara, our values shape everything we do. We're passionate about Delivering Excellence by putting the customer first, collaborating globally, and always striving to improve. We take smart risks and Innovate Boldly, setting new standards and learning from every experience. Integrity First is our cornerstone, we value humility, authenticity, and respect for diversity, building trust in all we do. We Embrace Curiosity by empowering you to experiment, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment. At Cyara, our values drive us forward, shaping a culture where innovation and excellence thrive. Agencies: Thanks, but we’ve got this one! Please, no phone calls or emails to any employees of Cyara outside of the Talent Acquisition team. Cyara’s policy is to only accept resumes from Agencies via the Cyara Agency Portal. Agencies must have a valid fee agreement in place, and they must have been assigned the specific requisition to which they submit resumes, by the Cyara Talent Acquisition team before submitting any CVs. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Cyara and, in the event, a candidate is submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
